frap-fe-draft.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
frap-fe-draft.reagents: Acetate 300 mM pH 3.6; TPTZ 10 mM in HCl 40 mM; FeCl3 20 mM; 10:1:1 v/v/v
frap-fe-draft.name: FRAP Fe(II) · 4 min
frap-fe-draft.notes: Subtract the reagent-blank change once. matrix_blank_delta is an additional net correction, not another reagent blank. Verify transfer to the sample matrix.

frap-trolox-draft.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
frap-trolox-draft.reagents: Not confirmed for this variant; consult the source. The 10:1:1 preparation is supplementary and must be checked.
frap-trolox-draft.standard_range: Not specified in the source; establish experimentally
frap-trolox-draft.name: FRAP Trolox · 30 min
frap-trolox-draft.notes: Room temperature, in the dark; record actual temperature. Finalise reagent preparation and calibration. This is the pineapple-core adaptation, not the original Fe(II) procedure.

abts-re.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
abts-re.reagents: ABTS 7 mM; potassium persulfate 2.45 mM final; 12–16 h in the dark; dilute with ethanol to A734=0.70±0.02.
abts-re.standard_range: 0–15 µmol/L in the final mixture according to the source; verify linearity
abts-re.name: ABTS · Re et al. · 6 min
abts-re.notes: Read at 6 min within the 1–6 min series; verify kinetics. blank = radical control with solvent at the same time. Response = 100*(A_control - A_corrected)/A_control. Do not subtract this control again as a reagent blank.

abts-adapted.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
abts-adapted.reagents: ABTS 7 mM; potassium persulfate 2.45 mM final; 12–16 h in the dark; dilute with ethanol to A734=0.70±0.02.
abts-adapted.name: ABTS · adapted · 30 min
abts-adapted.notes: Published adaptation: 30 min, 25±2 °C, vortex for approximately 5 s. Radical preparation is supplementary and requires confirmation. blank = solvent-matched radical control at the same time. Do not subtract it twice.

cuprac-apak.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
cuprac-apak.reagents: 1 mL CuCl2 10 mM + 1 mL neocuproine 7.5 mM + 1 mL ammonium acetate 1 M pH 7; x mL sample + (1.10−x) mL water.
cuprac-apak.standard_range: Select and verify the linear range
cuprac-apak.name: CUPRAC · normal · 60 min
cuprac-apak.notes: Enter aliquot x in µL and water to reach 4100 µL. 0<x≤1100 µL. Source procedure specifies 60 min while its summary mentions 30 min; this discrepancy is retained. No hydrolysis or heating is applied by default.

dpph-bw.mass_basis: dry extract; dose in the final mixture
dpph-bw.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
dpph-bw.reagents: DPPH 60 µmol/L in methanol; 0.10 mL sample + 3.90 mL reagent; methanol-matched control.
dpph-bw.standard_range: Select and verify the linear range
dpph-bw.name: DPPH · kinetics and EC50
dpph-bw.notes: Record kinetics at 0, 1 and every 15 min until plateau. The operator confirms the plateau. EC50 uses local linear interpolation between levels bracketing 50%, without extrapolation. Dose is mg dry extract/mL FINAL mixture (aliquot concentration /40). No fixed 30 min endpoint or molecular concentration of an extract is assumed.

tpc-folin.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
tpc-folin.reagents: 100 µL sample + 200 µL Folin reagent 10% v/v + 800 µL Na2CO3 700 mM. Add Folin BEFORE alkali. Read 200 µL transferred to a plate.
tpc-folin.standard_range: 50–2500 µmol/L before reaction; select the linear region
tpc-folin.name: TPC · Folin–Ciocalteu · 120 min
tpc-folin.notes: Convert gallic acid from µmol/L to mg/L using 170.12/1000. Transfer to a plate adds no dilution. Folin reagent also responds to other reducing compounds; TPC is an operational estimate. Background: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0076-6879(99)99017-1

tpc-adapted.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
tpc-adapted.reagents: 200 µL extract + 500 µL water + 500 µL Na2CO3 7.5%; wait 5 min; add 100 µL Folin reagent 2 N. Incubate 30 min in the dark.
tpc-adapted.name: TPC · adapted · 30 min
tpc-adapted.notes: Addition order differs from the base TPC method. Confirm whether Na2CO3 percentage is w/v. Do not interchange variants. Calibration concentration before reaction is in mg/L.

tfc-alcl3-qe.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
tfc-alcl3-qe.reagents: 0.5 mL sample + 1.5 mL ethanol 95% + 0.1 mL AlCl3 10% + 0.1 mL potassium acetate 1 M + 2.8 mL water; 30 min; 415 nm.
tfc-alcl3-qe.standard_range: Select and verify the linear range
tfc-alcl3-qe.name: TFC · AlCl3 · quercetin · 30 min
tfc-alcl3-qe.notes: AlCl3 method following Chang et al. (2002), with the operational adaptation reported in https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-023-42418-1 . Quercetin calibration; report mg QE/g. This response does not quantify all flavonoid classes. Extraction is a separate procedure. Record actual temperature. Validate suitability for the sample matrix.

moisture-oven.mass_basis: initial sample mass; record sample state
moisture-oven.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
moisture-oven.name: Moisture · oven at 105 °C
moisture-oven.notes: Approximately 10 g; duplicate determinations. Dry to constant mass and record cycles and the constancy criterion. No fixed drying duration is invented.

dry-matter.mass_basis: initial sample mass; record sample state
dry-matter.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
dry-matter.name: Dry matter · 105 °C
dry-matter.notes: Triplicate determinations; dry to constant mass. Dry matter and moisture are complementary only for the same aliquot and drying conditions. Other assays are not normalised automatically.

ash-500.mass_basis: initial sample mass; record sample state
ash-500.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
ash-500.name: Ash · 500 °C · 6 h
ash-500.notes: Triplicate determinations. Establish sample mass and the heating ramp. Specify initial or dry mass basis; do not correct moisture twice.

moisture-adapted.mass_basis: initial sample mass; record sample state
moisture-adapted.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
moisture-adapted.name: Moisture · adapted · TAPPI conditions required
moisture-adapted.blocked_reason: Identify the TAPPI standard and operating conditions. Preparative drying at 40 °C for 48 h is NOT the moisture assay.
moisture-adapted.notes: Document the standard edition, sample state, mass, temperature and endpoint before use. Conditions from the oven method must not be attributed to this adaptation.

ash-adapted.mass_basis: initial sample mass; record sample state
ash-adapted.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
ash-adapted.name: Ash · adapted · TAPPI conditions required
ash-adapted.blocked_reason: TAPPI standard, temperature, duration and endpoint are missing; do not attribute 500 °C/6 h to this source.
ash-adapted.notes: Complete the operating conditions from the identified standard before use. A thermal residue under nitrogen is not equivalent to oxidative ash.

sieve-mass.qc_policy: Illustrative software QC thresholds; not analytical method validation criteria
sieve-mass.name: Particle size · mass distribution
sieve-mass.notes: Enter actual sieve openings and passing/retained fraction limits. Recovery refers to loaded mass; do not renormalise to 100%. Define time and amplitude. Recovery limits are illustrative and editable. Additional source: https://doi.org/10.3390/foods3010066

en_to_es.Illustrative software QC thresholds; not: Umbrales de software ilustrativos; no criterios de validación del método
en_to_es.Acetate 300 mM pH 3.6; TPTZ 10 mM in HCl: Acetato 300 mM pH 3.6; TPTZ 10 mM en HCl 40 mM; FeCl3 20 mM; 10:1:1 v/v/v
Restar delta del blanco de reactivos una vez. matrix_blank_delta es corrección adicional neta, no otro blanco de reactivos.
en_to_es.Not confirmed for this variant; consult: No confirmados para esta variante; consultar fuente. Receta 10:1:1 es complemento provisional.
en_to_es.Not specified in the source; establish e: No especificado en fuente; definir experimentalmente
en_to_es.Room temperature, in the dark; record ac: Temperatura ambiente, en oscuridad; registra la temperatura real. Completa reactivos y calibración. Es la adaptación del corazón de piña, no el procedimiento original con Fe(II).
en_to_es.ABTS 7 mM; potassium persulfate 2.45 mM: ABTS 7 mM; persulfato 2,45 mM final; 12–16 h oscuridad; diluir con etanol hasta A734=0,70±0,02.
en_to_es.0–15 µmol/L in the final mixture accordi: 0–15 µmol/L finales según fuente; verificar linealidad
en_to_es.Read at 6 min within the 1–6 min series;: Punto de lectura a 6 min de la serie 1–6 min; confirmar cinética. Tipo blank = control radical con disolvente, a idéntico tiempo. Respuesta = 100*(A_control - A_corregida)/A_control. No restar de nuevo el control como blanco.
en_to_es.Published adaptation: 30 min, 25±2 °C, v: Punto de lectura a 6 min de la serie 1–6 min; confirmar cinética. Tipo blank = control radical con disolvente, a idéntico tiempo. Respuesta = 100*(A_control - A_corregida)/A_control. No restar de nuevo el control como blanco. Variante publicada 30 min, 25±2 °C, vórtex ~5 s. Preparación del radical complementaria, por confirmar.
en_to_es.1 mL CuCl2 10 mM + 1 mL neocuproine 7.5: 1 mL CuCl2 10 mM + 1 mL neocuproína 7,5 mM + 1 mL acetato amónico 1 M pH 7; x mL muestra + (1,10−x) mL agua.
en_to_es.Select and verify the linear range: Seleccionar y verificar el intervalo lineal
en_to_es.Enter aliquot x in µL and water to reach: Introducir alícuota x en µL y agua para completar 4100 µL. 0<x≤1100 µL. Fuente: procedimiento 60 min; resumen 30 min, discrepancia conservada. No se adopta hidrólisis ni calentamiento por defecto.
en_to_es.dry extract; dose in the final mixture: extracto seco; dosis en mezcla final
en_to_es.DPPH 60 µmol/L in methanol; 0.10 mL samp: DPPH 60 µmol/L en metanol; 0,10 mL muestra + 3,90 mL reactivo; control con metanol.
en_to_es.Record kinetics at 0, 1 and every 15 min: Registrar cinética 0, 1 y cada 15 min hasta meseta. Marcar meseta confirmada por el operador. EC50 por interpolación lineal local entre niveles que encierran 50%; decisión informática explícita, sin extrapolar. Dosis en mg de extracto seco/mL FINAL (alícuota /40). No se asignan 30 min ni una molaridad del extracto.
en_to_es.100 µL sample + 200 µL Folin reagent 10%: 100 µL muestra + 200 µL Folin 10% v/v + 800 µL Na2CO3 700 mM. Folin ANTES del álcali. Lectura de 200 µL transferidos a placa.
en_to_es.50–2500 µmol/L before reaction; select t: 50–2500 µmol/L antes de reacción; seleccionar tramo lineal
en_to_es.Convert gallic acid from µmol/L to mg/L: Conversión de µmol/L a mg/L: 170,12/1000 para ácido gálico. La transferencia a placa no añade dilución. Folin responde a otros reductores; TPC operacional.
en_to_es.200 µL extract + 500 µL water + 500 µL N: 200 µL extracto + 500 µL agua + 500 µL Na2CO3 7,5%; esperar 5 min; añadir 100 µL Folin 2 N. 30 min oscuridad.
en_to_es.Addition order differs from the base TPC: Orden de adición distinto de TPC base. Base m/v de Na2CO3 por confirmar. No intercambiar variantes. Concentración antes de reacción en mg/L.
en_to_es.0.5 mL sample + 1.5 mL ethanol 95% + 0.1: 0,5 mL muestra + 1,5 mL etanol 95% + 0,1 mL AlCl3 10% + 0,1 mL acetato potásico 1 M + 2,8 mL agua; 30 min; 415 nm.
en_to_es.AlCl3 method following Chang et al. (200: Base publicada en Scientific Reports 2023, siguiendo Chang et al. 2002 (doi:10.38212/2224-6614.2748). Quercetina; resultado mg QE/g. Respuesta selectiva AlCl3, no cuantifica todas las clases de flavonoides. Preparación de extracción independiente. Temperatura numérica no fijada; registrar real. No es norma ni método validado para olivo.
en_to_es.Approximately 10 g; duplicate determinat: 10 g aproximados; duplicados. Hasta masa constante; documentar ciclos y criterio de constancia. No se inventa una duración fija.
en_to_es.Triplicate determinations; dry to consta: Triplicados; hasta masa constante. MS y humedad son complementarias si proceden de la misma alícuota. No se normalizan otros ensayos automáticamente.
en_to_es.Triplicate determinations. Establish sam: Triplicados. Masa de ensayo y rampa por fijar. Base inicial o seca explícita; no corregir humedad dos veces.
en_to_es.Identify the TAPPI standard and operatin: Falta identificar norma TAPPI y condiciones. El presecado 40 °C/48 h NO es el ensayo de humedad.
en_to_es.Document the standard edition, sample st: Documenta la edición de la norma, estado de muestra, masa, temperatura y punto final antes de usar. No atribuir a esta adaptación las condiciones del método de estufa.
en_to_es.TAPPI standard, temperature, duration an: Faltan norma TAPPI, temperatura, duración y punto final; no heredar 500 °C/6 h como publicados.
en_to_es.Complete the operating conditions from t: Completa las condiciones operativas con la norma identificada antes de usar. Un residuo térmico bajo nitrógeno no equivale a cenizas oxidativas.
en_to_es.Enter actual sieve openings and passing/: Adaptación de distribución másica: introducir aberturas reales y fracción pasante–retenida. Cierre respecto a masa cargada; no normalizar al 100%. Fijar tiempo y amplitud. Umbrales de recuperación ilustrativos, editables.
